    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Full-featured: keyboard nav, touch/swipe,
       scroll wheel, progress bar, nav dots,
       Intersection Observer for animations
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.scrollCooldown = 800; /* ms between scroll-triggered slides */

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            this.setupNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupScrollNav();
            this.updateProgress(0);
        }

        /* --- Navigation Dots --- */
        setupNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        updateDots(index) {
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === index));
        }

        /* --- Progress Bar --- */
        updateProgress(index) {
            const pct = this.slides.length > 1
                ? (index / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100
                : 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* --- Intersection Observer — triggers .visible for animations --- */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateDots(idx);
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* --- Keyboard Navigation --- */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.next();
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.prev();
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / Swipe Navigation --- */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let startY = 0;
            let startX = 0;
            const THRESHOLD = 50;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const deltaY = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const deltaX = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                /* Prefer vertical swipes */
                if (Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX) && Math.abs(deltaY) > THRESHOLD) {
                    deltaY > 0 ? this.next() : this.prev();
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Mouse Wheel Navigation --- */
        setupScrollNav() {
            let lastScroll = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastScroll < this.scrollCooldown) return;
                lastScroll = now;
                e.deltaY > 0 ? this.next() : this.prev();
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Slide navigation helpers --- */
        goTo(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            this.currentSlide = index;
        }

        next() { this.goTo(this.currentSlide + 1); }
        prev() { this.goTo(this.currentSlide - 1); }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
        /* Trigger animations for the first slide immediately */
        const firstSlide = document.querySelector('.slide');
        if (firstSlide) {
            setTimeout(() => firstSlide.classList.add('visible'), 100);
        }
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>

    <style>
        /* ===========================================
           CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES (THEME)
           Swiss-Modern-meets-Data-Journalism aesthetic
           Inspired by NYT Climate desk + IPCC report design
           =========================================== */
        :root {
            /* Core palette — deep ink on off-white, with temperature-scale accents */
            --bg-primary: #f4f1ec;
            --bg-secondary: #eae6de;
            --bg-dark: #1a1710;
            --bg-card: #ffffff;
            --text-primary: #1a1710;
            --text-secondary: #5a5650;
            --text-muted: #9a9690;
            --text-light: #f4f1ec;

            /* Data accent colors — temperature / climate spectrum */
            --accent-red: #d4380d;
            --accent-orange: #f26b30;
            --accent-amber: #e8a020;
            --accent-blue: #1a6aaf;
            --accent-teal: #1a8a7a;
            --accent-dark-red: #8b1a0a;

            /* Chart-specific */
            --chart-us: #d4380d;
            --chart-china: #e8a020;
            --chart-india: #f26b30;
            --chart-eu: #1a6aaf;
            --chart-russia: #7a6aaf;
            --chart-other: #9a9690;

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'DM Mono', monospace;

            /* Typography scale — ALL use clamp() */
            --title-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 1.6rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.4vw, 1.05rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            --data-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem);
            --big-num-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 5rem);
            --medium-num-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);

            /* Spacing */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 5rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.65s;
            --duration-slow: 1s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESET
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT BASE CSS (mandatory — included verbatim)
           =========================================== */

        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;

        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;

            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;

        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);

        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {

                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);

                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-32px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal,
        .slide.visible .reveal-left,
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: none;
        }

        /* Stagger delays */
        .reveal:nth-child(1), .reveal-left:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.08s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2), .reveal-left:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.18s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3), .reveal-left:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.28s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.38s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5), .reveal-left:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.48s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6), .reveal-left:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.58s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7), .reveal-left:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.66s; }

        /* Bar grow animation */
        @keyframes barGrow {
            from { width: 0; }
            to { width: var(--bar-width); }
        }

        @keyframes barGrowH {
            from { height: 0; }
            to { height: var(--bar-height); }
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-animate {
            animation: barGrow var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
            animation-delay: var(--bar-delay, 0.3s);

        .slide.visible .bar-animate-h {

            animation-delay: var(--bar-delay, 0.3s);

        /* Number counter */
        @keyframes fadeNum {

        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION & PROGRESS
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {

            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-red);

        /* ===========================================

        .hbar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);

        .hbar-row.highlight .hbar-value {

           SLIDE 6: PER CAPITA SNAPSHOT TABLE

            gap: clamp(0.15rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);

        .pcap-row {

            font-family: var(--font-mono);

        .pcap-bar-track {
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vh, 14px);

            border-radius: 2px;

        .pcap-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .pcap-bar-fill {
            width: var(--bar-width);
        }

        .pcap-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .pcap-row.world-avg .pcap-country,

            color: var(--accent-blue);

        }

        .pcap-row.highlight-us .pcap-country,
        .pcap-row.highlight-us .pcap-val {
            color: var(--accent-red);

        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: 2024 DIVERGING BAR
           =========================================== */
        .divbar-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
        }

        .divbar-chart {
            flex: 1.6;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .divbar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }

        .divbar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;

            position: relative;
            flex: 1;

            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .divbar-zero {
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            top: 0;
            width: 1px;

        }

        .divbar-neg {
            position: absolute;
            right: 50%;
            height: 100%;

        .divbar-pos {
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
            width: 0;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .divbar-neg { width: var(--bar-neg); }

        .divbar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);

        .divbar-side {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;

        }

        .divbar-legend {
            display: flex;

            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);

        .divbar-legend-item {

        .divbar-swatch {
            width: clamp(12px, 1.5vw, 18px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vh, 12px);
            border-radius: 2px;
            flex-shrink: 0;

           SLIDE 8: ENERGY MIX — COMPARATIVE BARS
           =========================================== */
        .energy-grid {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);

        .energy-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .energy-col-title {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;

            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        .energy-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem) 1fr clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }

        .energy-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .energy-track {
            height: clamp(10px, 1.5vh, 16px);
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .energy-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .energy-fill { width: var(--bar-width); }

        .energy-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .energy-insight {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);

            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .energy-insight p {
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .energy-insight strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

           SLIDE 9: TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-slide {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);

        .takeaway-inner {
            flex: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);

            min-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;

            display: flex;

        .takeaway-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--big-num-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);

            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);

            letter-spacing: 0.12em;

        .takeaway-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .takeaway-slide .slide-heading {
            color: var(--text-light);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .takeaway-icon {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);
            height: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);

            background: var(--accent-red);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .takeaway-icon svg {
            width: clamp(8px, 1vw, 11px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1vw, 11px);
        }

        .takeaway-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: rgba(244,241,236,0.75);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .takeaway-text strong {
            color: var(--text-light);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           UTILITY
           =========================================== */
        .flex-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }

        .stat-callout {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--medium-num-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        /* Divider rule */
        .hr-thin {
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            width: 100%;
            margin: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem) 0;
        }

        /* Insight box */
        .insight-box {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-red);

        .insight-box p {
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .insight-box strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SVG CHART STYLES
           =========================================== */
        .chart-line {
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2.5;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        .chart-area {
            opacity: 0.85;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESPONSIVE — hide nav dots on very small screens
           =========================================== */
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .nav-dots { display: none; }
            .treemap-grid {

            .cell-africa{ display: none; }
            .cell-sa    { display: none; }
            .cell-intl  { display: none; }
            .cell-other { display: none; }
        }

    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Full-featured: keyboard nav, touch/swipe,
       scroll wheel, progress bar, nav dots,
       Intersection Observer for animations
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.scrollCooldown = 800; /* ms between scroll-triggered slides */

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            this.setupNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupScrollNav();
            this.updateProgress(0);
        }

        /* --- Navigation Dots --- */
        setupNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        updateDots(index) {
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === index));
        }

        /* --- Progress Bar --- */
        updateProgress(index) {
            const pct = this.slides.length > 1
                ? (index / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100
                : 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* --- Intersection Observer — triggers .visible for animations --- */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateDots(idx);
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* --- Keyboard Navigation --- */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.next();
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.prev();
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / Swipe Navigation --- */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let startY = 0;
            let startX = 0;
            const THRESHOLD = 50;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const deltaY = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const deltaX = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                /* Prefer vertical swipes */
                if (Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX) && Math.abs(deltaY) > THRESHOLD) {
                    deltaY > 0 ? this.next() : this.prev();
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Mouse Wheel Navigation --- */
        setupScrollNav() {
            let lastScroll = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastScroll < this.scrollCooldown) return;
                lastScroll = now;
                e.deltaY > 0 ? this.next() : this.prev();
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Slide navigation helpers --- */
        goTo(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            this.currentSlide = index;
        }

        next() { this.goTo(this.currentSlide + 1); }
        prev() { this.goTo(this.currentSlide - 1); }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
        /* Trigger animations for the first slide immediately */
        const firstSlide = document.querySelector('.slide');
        if (firstSlide) {
            setTimeout(() => firstSlide.classList.add('visible'), 100);
        }
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>

            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-32px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal,
        .slide.visible .reveal-left,
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: none;
        }

        /* Stagger delays */
        .reveal:nth-child(1), .reveal-left:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.08s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2), .reveal-left:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.18s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3), .reveal-left:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.28s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4), .reveal-left:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.38s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5), .reveal-left:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.48s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6), .reveal-left:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.58s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7), .reveal-left:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.66s; }

        /* Bar grow animation */
        @keyframes barGrow {
            from { width: 0; }
            to { width: var(--bar-width); }
        }

        @keyframes barGrowH {
            from { height: 0; }
            to { height: var(--bar-height); }
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-animate {
            animation: barGrow var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
            animation-delay: var(--bar-delay, 0.3s);
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-animate-h {
            animation: barGrowH var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
            animation-delay: var(--bar-delay, 0.3s);
        }

        /* Line draw animation */
        @keyframes lineDraw {
            to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
        }

        .slide.visible .line-draw {
            animation: lineDraw 1.4s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
            animation-delay: 0.4s;
        }

        /* Number counter */
        @keyframes fadeNum {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAVIGATION & PROGRESS
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s var(--ease-in-out);
        }

        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            z-index: 999;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(26, 23, 16, 0.25);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-red);
            transform: scale(1.5);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE COUNTER
           =========================================== */
        .slide-counter {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .source-tag {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            left: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .slide-title {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
        }

        /* Asymmetric red accent block */
        .title-accent-bar {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            width: clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px);
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--accent-red);
        }

        .title-corner-grid {
            position: absolute;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 40%;
            height: 60%;
            opacity: 0.04;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(244,241,236,0.8) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(244,241,236,0.8) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px) clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
        }

        .title-inner {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-left: calc(var(--slide-padding) + clamp(6px, 1vw, 12px) + clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem));
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            height: 100%;
            max-width: 75%;
        }

        .deck-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            line-height: 1.08;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            color: var(--text-light);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 300;
            color: rgba(244, 241, 236, 0.65);
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            max-width: 52ch;
        }

        .title-divider {
            width: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 5rem);
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
        }

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .meta-item {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(244, 241, 236, 0.45);
        }

        .meta-item span {
            color: rgba(244, 241, 236, 0.75);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE HEADER (shared)
           =========================================== */
        .slide-header {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-bottom: 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .slide-heading {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: 28ch;
        }

        .slide-heading em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: GLOBAL TRAJECTORY — LINE CHART
           =========================================== */
        .chart-slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .chart-body {
            flex: 1;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: 0 var(--slide-padding) var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .area-chart-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            position: relative;
        }

        .area-chart-wrap svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        /* Annotation callouts */
        .chart-annotation {
            position: absolute;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .annot-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .annot-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);
        }

        /* chart y-axis labels */
        .axis-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            fill: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: REGIONAL SHARE — STACKED AREA
           =========================================== */
        .stacked-legend {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
            align-items: center;
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .legend-swatch {
            width: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 14px);
            height: clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 14px);
            border-radius: 2px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: TREEMAP / COUNTRY SHARES
           =========================================== */
        .treemap-grid {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 3.1fr 1.3fr 0.8fr 0.6fr 0.5fr;
            grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(3px, 0.5vw, 6px);
        }

        .treemap-cell {
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
        }

        .treemap-cell:hover {
            transform: scale(1.015);
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .cell-country {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: rgba(244,241,236,0.9);
            letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        }

        .cell-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            color: #fff;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .cell-trend {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        /* China spans two rows */
        .cell-china { grid-row: 1 / 3; background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .cell-us    { grid-row: 1 / 2; background: var(--accent-red); }
        .cell-india { grid-row: 2 / 3; background: var(--accent-orange); }
        .cell-eu    { grid-row: 1 / 2; background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .cell-russia{ grid-row: 2 / 3; background: #5a5090; }
        .cell-africa{ background: var(--accent-teal); }
        .cell-sa    { background: #4a8a5a; }
        .cell-intl  { background: var(--text-muted); }
        .cell-other { background: #888; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: PER CAPITA HORIZONTAL BAR
           =========================================== */
        .hbar-chart {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .hbar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .hbar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 7rem);
        }

        .hbar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(12px, 2vh, 20px);
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .hbar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .hbar-fill {
            width: var(--bar-width);
        }

        .hbar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
        }

        /* World average reference line */
        .hbar-avg-line {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            width: 2px;
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--accent-blue);
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        /* Highlight rows */
        .hbar-row.highlight .hbar-label {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .hbar-row.highlight .hbar-value {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: PER CAPITA SNAPSHOT TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .pcap-table {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.15rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .pcap-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 7rem) 1fr clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem) 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        .pcap-row.header-row {
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--text-primary);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .pcap-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .pcap-bar-track {
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vh, 14px);
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pcap-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .pcap-bar-fill {
            width: var(--bar-width);
        }

        .pcap-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .pcap-row.world-avg .pcap-country,
        .pcap-row.world-avg .pcap-val {
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .pcap-row.highlight-us .pcap-country,
        .pcap-row.highlight-us .pcap-val {
            color: var(--accent-red);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: 2024 DIVERGING BAR
           =========================================== */
        .divbar-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
        }

        .divbar-chart {
            flex: 1.6;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .divbar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }

        .divbar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem);
        }

        .divbar-center {
            position: relative;
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(12px, 1.8vh, 20px);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .divbar-zero {
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            top: 0;
            width: 1px;
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--text-primary);
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        .divbar-neg {
            position: absolute;
            right: 50%;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px 0 0 2px;
            width: 0;
            background: var(--accent-blue);
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .divbar-pos {
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
            width: 0;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .divbar-neg { width: var(--bar-neg); }
        .slide.visible .divbar-pos { width: var(--bar-pos); }

        .divbar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(2.2rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
        }

        .divbar-side {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .divbar-legend {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .divbar-legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
        }

        .divbar-swatch {
            width: clamp(12px, 1.5vw, 18px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vh, 12px);
            border-radius: 2px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: ENERGY MIX — COMPARATIVE BARS
           =========================================== */
        .energy-grid {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
        }

        .energy-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .energy-col-title {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        .energy-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem) 1fr clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }

        .energy-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .energy-track {
            height: clamp(10px, 1.5vh, 16px);
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .energy-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .energy-fill { width: var(--bar-width); }

        .energy-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .energy-insight {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .energy-insight p {
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .energy-insight strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 9: TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-slide {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
        }

        .takeaway-inner {
            flex: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            min-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .takeaway-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            border-right: 1px solid rgba(244,241,236,0.1);
            padding-right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
        }

        .takeaway-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--big-num-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            line-height: 1;
            letter-spacing: -0.04em;
        }

        .takeaway-num-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(244,241,236,0.4);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .takeaway-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .takeaway-slide .slide-heading {
            color: var(--text-light);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .takeaway-icon {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);
            height: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .takeaway-icon svg {
            width: clamp(8px, 1vw, 11px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1vw, 11px);
        }

        .takeaway-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: rgba(244,241,236,0.75);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

<script>
    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Full-featured: keyboard nav, touch/swipe,
       scroll wheel, progress bar, nav dots,
       Intersection Observer for animations
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.scrollCooldown = 800; /* ms between scroll-triggered slides */

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            this.setupNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupScrollNav();
            this.updateProgress(0);
        }

        /* --- Navigation Dots --- */
        setupNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        updateDots(index) {
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === index));
        }

        /* --- Progress Bar --- */
        updateProgress(index) {
            const pct = this.slides.length > 1
                ? (index / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100
                : 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* --- Intersection Observer — triggers .visible for animations --- */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateDots(idx);
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* --- Keyboard Navigation --- */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.next();
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.prev();
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / Swipe Navigation --- */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let startY = 0;
            let startX = 0;
            const THRESHOLD = 50;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const deltaY = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const deltaX = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                /* Prefer vertical swipes */
                if (Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX) && Math.abs(deltaY) > THRESHOLD) {
                    deltaY > 0 ? this.next() : this.prev();
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Mouse Wheel Navigation --- */
        setupScrollNav() {
            let lastScroll = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastScroll < this.scrollCooldown) return;
                lastScroll = now;
                e.deltaY > 0 ? this.next() : this.prev();
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Slide navigation helpers --- */
        goTo(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            this.currentSlide = index;
        }

        next() { this.goTo(this.currentSlide + 1); }
        prev() { this.goTo(this.currentSlide - 1); }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
        /* Trigger animations for the first slide immediately */
        const firstSlide = document.querySelector('.slide');
        if (firstSlide) {
            setTimeout(() => firstSlide.classList.add('visible'), 100);
        }
    });
</script>
</body>
</html>

        /* ===========================================

           =========================================== */
        :root {

            --bg-primary: #f4f1ec;

        /* ===========================================

        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

           =========================================== */

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {

        @media (max-height: 700px) {

        @media (max-height: 600px) {

        @media (max-height: 500px) {

           BASE TYPOGRAPHY

        .pcap-row.highlight-us .pcap-val {

            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: 2024 DIVERGING BAR
           =========================================== */
        .divbar-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
        }

        .divbar-chart {
            flex: 1.6;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .divbar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }

        .divbar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 6rem);
        }

        .divbar-center {
            position: relative;
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(12px, 1.8vh, 20px);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .divbar-zero {
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            top: 0;
            width: 1px;
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--text-primary);
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        .divbar-neg {
            position: absolute;
            right: 50%;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px 0 0 2px;
            width: 0;
            background: var(--accent-blue);
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .divbar-pos {
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;
            width: 0;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .divbar-neg { width: var(--bar-neg); }
        .slide.visible .divbar-pos { width: var(--bar-pos); }

        .divbar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(2.2rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
        }

        .divbar-side {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .divbar-legend {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .divbar-legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
        }

        .divbar-swatch {
            width: clamp(12px, 1.5vw, 18px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vh, 12px);
            border-radius: 2px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: ENERGY MIX — COMPARATIVE BARS
           =========================================== */
        .energy-grid {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
        }

        .energy-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }

        .energy-col-title {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        .energy-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem) 1fr clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
        }

        .energy-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .energy-track {
            height: clamp(10px, 1.5vh, 16px);
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .energy-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 0.9s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .energy-fill { width: var(--bar-width); }

        .energy-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .energy-insight {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .energy-insight p {
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .energy-insight strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 9: TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-slide {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
        }

        .takeaway-inner {
            flex: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            min-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .takeaway-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            border-right: 1px solid rgba(244,241,236,0.1);
            padding-right: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
        }

        .takeaway-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--big-num-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            line-height: 1;
            letter-spacing: -0.04em;
        }

        .takeaway-num-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(244,241,236,0.4);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .takeaway-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .takeaway-slide .slide-heading {
            color: var(--text-light);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
        }

        .takeaway-icon {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);
            height: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent-red);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .takeaway-icon svg {
            width: clamp(8px, 1vw, 11px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1vw, 11px);
        }

        .takeaway-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: rgba(244,241,236,0.75);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .takeaway-text strong {
            color: var(--text-light);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           UTILITY
           =========================================== */
        .flex-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }

        .stat-callout {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--medium-num-size);
            color: var(--accent-red);
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        /* Divider rule */
        .hr-thin {
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            width: 100%;
            margin: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem) 0;
        }

        /* Insight box */
        .insight-box {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-red);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
        }

        .insight-box p {
            font-size: var(--data-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .insight-box strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SVG CHART STYLES
           =========================================== */
        .chart-line {
            fill: none;
            stroke-width: 2.5;
            stroke-linecap: round;
            stroke-linejoin: round;
        }

        .chart-area {
            opacity: 0.85;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESPONSIVE — hide nav dots on very small screens
           =========================================== */
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .nav-dots { display: none; }
            .treemap-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 1fr);
            }
            .cell-china { grid-row: 1; grid-column: 1 / 3; }
            .cell-us    { grid-row: 2; grid-column: 1; }
            .cell-india { grid-row: 2; grid-column: 2; }
            .cell-eu    { grid-row: 3; grid-column: 1; }
            .cell-russia{ grid-row: 3; grid-column: 2; }
            .cell-africa{ display: none; }
            .cell-sa    { display: none; }
            .cell-intl  { display: none; }
            .cell-other { display: none; }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    /* ===========================================
       SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
       Full-featured: keyboard nav, touch/swipe,
       scroll wheel, progress bar, nav dots,
       Intersection Observer for animations
       =========================================== */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.scrollCooldown = 800; /* ms between scroll-triggered slides */

            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.navDotsContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');

            this.init();
        }

        init() {
            this.setupNavDots();
            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupScrollNav();
            this.updateProgress(0);
        }

        /* --- Navigation Dots --- */
        setupNavDots() {
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                this.navDotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
            });
            this.dots = Array.from(this.navDotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot'));
        }

        updateDots(index) {
            this.dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === index));
        }

        /* --- Progress Bar --- */
        updateProgress(index) {
            const pct = this.slides.length > 1
                ? (index / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100
                : 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* --- Intersection Observer — triggers .visible for animations --- */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateDots(idx);
                            this.updateProgress(idx);
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* --- Keyboard Navigation --- */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch (e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown':
                    case 'ArrowRight':
                    case ' ':
                    case 'PageDown':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.next();
                        break;
                    case 'ArrowUp':
                    case 'ArrowLeft':
                    case 'PageUp':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.prev();
                        break;
                    case 'Home':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(0);
                        break;
                    case 'End':
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goTo(this.slides.length - 1);
                        break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* --- Touch / Swipe Navigation --- */
        setupTouchNav() {
            let startY = 0;
            let startX = 0;
            const THRESHOLD = 50;

            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const deltaY = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                const deltaX = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                /* Prefer vertical swipes */
                if (Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX) && Math.abs(deltaY) > THRESHOLD) {
                    deltaY > 0 ? this.next() : this.prev();
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Mouse Wheel Navigation --- */
        setupScrollNav() {
            let lastScroll = 0;
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                const now = Date.now();
                if (now - lastScroll < this.scrollCooldown) return;
                lastScroll = now;
                e.deltaY > 0 ? this.next() : this.prev();
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* --- Slide navigation helpers --- */
        goTo(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            this.currentSlide = index;
        }

        next() { this.goTo(this.currentSlide + 1); }
        prev() { this.goTo(this.currentSlide - 1); }
    }

    /* Initialize on DOM ready */
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        new SlidePresentation();
        /* Trigger animations for the first slide immediately */
        const firstSlide = document.querySelector('.slide');
        if (firstSlide) {
            setTimeout(() => firstSlide.classList.add('visible'), 100);
        }
    });
</script>

118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes

121	    return unique

124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler

193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198	
199	    html_path = Path(args.input_html).resolve()
200	    output_path = Path(args.output_pptx).resolve()

209	        print(f"Captured {len(images)} unique slide(s), assembling PPTX ...")
